title: Juicy Indulgent Jamaican Chicken Pilaf
description: A fresh and indulgent Jamaican dish featuring jasmine rice and juicy chicken, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is nut-free and features a brine-dry method for tender chicken.
instructions: Rinse the chicken pieces and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together chicken broth, coconut milk, scotch bonnet peppers, garlic, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
In a large saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chicken pieces to the saucepan and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the jasmine rice to the saucepan and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the marinade to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
